title: Binary Search
prompt: Given a sorted (ascending) integer array `nums` and an integer `target`, return the index of `target` in `nums`, or -1 if it is not present. Your solution must run in O(log n) time.
constraints: nums is sorted in ascending order.
All integers in nums are unique.
hints: The O(log n) requirement is a strong hint — think divide and conquer.
Maintain a low and high pointer, compare nums[mid] to target, and shrink the search space by half each time.
Watch your loop condition and midpoint calculation to avoid infinite loops or off-by-one errors.
